verdict.rationale: Cactus is an on-device inference engine, so combined CPU+GPU offload for oversized models is a fair axis to judge it on. Nothing in the evidence documents layer splitting or hybrid offload; the materials describe CPU-only operation ('no GPU'), and community reports say the GPU goes unused for inference on Apple and Pixel devices. Vendoring llama.cpp is not evidence that Cactus exposes offload itself.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run models larger than my available VRAM using combined CPU+GPU offload
